timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,125.31 Cr (+4.6% YoY), net profit ₹14.98 Cr (+69.8% YoY).
2026-05-29: Board approved ₹67 Cr investment for a 5000 TPA high-purity hydrogen peroxide plant at Dahej.
Gujarat Alkalies partnered with CleanMax for a 75.9 MW wind and 84.34 MWp solar hybrid power project for captive consumption.
Gujarat Alkalies conducted the ground-breaking ceremony for its 33,870 TPA Phosphoric Acid plant PPA-II facility at Dahej.
